title: ClusterQueue not active

definition.name: [Kueue] ClusterQueue is not active
definition.message:
{{#is_alert}}
## What's happening?

ClusterQueue **{{kueue_cluster_queue.name}}** is not active (status value {{value}}, threshold {{threshold}}) — it is reporting `pending` or `terminated` instead of `active`.
{{/is_alert}}

{{#is_recovery}}
## Recovered

ClusterQueue on {{kueue_cluster_queue.name}} has resolved and is now active. Current value: {{value}}.
{{/is_recovery}}

{{^is_recovery}}

---

## Impact

While a ClusterQueue is not active, it cannot admit any workloads, so jobs targeting it will remain queued indefinitely and never start running.

---

## Why?

Possible causes:
* **Missing ResourceFlavor** — the ClusterQueue references a ResourceFlavor that does not exist in the cluster, so Kueue cannot resolve the quota it needs to admit workloads.
* **Missing or failing AdmissionCheck** — the ClusterQueue requires an AdmissionCheck that is not yet Active, preventing admission until the check is satisfied.
* **ClusterQueue being terminated** — the ClusterQueue is in the process of being deleted (finalizing pending workloads) and will stop admitting new work until deletion completes or is cancelled.

---

## How to troubleshoot and resolve the issue?

1. **Identify the scope** — Check which `{{kueue_cluster_queue.name}}` is affected.
2. **Review recent metrics** — Inspect `kueue.cluster_queue.status` in [Metrics Explorer](https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?exp_metric=kueue.cluster_queue.status&exp_scope=kueue_cluster_queue:{{kueue_cluster_queue.name}},env:{{env.name}}&exp_agg=avg&exp_type=line) to confirm whether the queue is stuck in `pending` or `terminated`.
3. Run `kubectl describe clusterqueue {{kueue_cluster_queue.name}}` and check the `Active` condition's reason/message for the specific misconfiguration (missing ResourceFlavor, missing AdmissionCheck, etc.).
4. If a ResourceFlavor is missing, create it or update the ClusterQueue spec to reference an existing one. If an AdmissionCheck is not active, investigate and fix the corresponding check controller.

| Cause | Resolution |
| ----- | ---------- |
| Missing ResourceFlavor | Create the referenced ResourceFlavor or correct the ClusterQueue's `spec.resourceGroups` to reference a flavor that exists. |
| Missing/failing AdmissionCheck | Ensure the required AdmissionCheck and its controller are deployed and reporting `Active`. |
| ClusterQueue terminating | Confirm whether deletion is intentional; if not, remove the deletion request and verify no lingering finalizers block workload cleanup. |

---
